items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: He taught Ray Brown and all those bass players from Pittsburgh.

ctx.x: And I met -- which I was just about 17, you know. I didn't have a job or anything. So there was a friend of mine in school named Frank Clarke who was a wonderful bassist, you know, and well we had a band at Herron Hill, so we had a -- oh, what's his name? He was an Irish fellow. He taught Ray Brown and all those bass players from Pittsburgh.
Really? Well, does Ray Brown come from Pittsburgh?
